why: One accepted fetch, normalized and reduced, before any override. `npm run data:apply` re-merges this with data/overrides/ offline, which is how an editorial edit reaches data/build/ without a network round trip. This first snapshot is not a fetch: it is the committed v7 dataset read back as if a fetch had just produced it, so that data:apply is a verified no-op on a clean tree from the day it lands. The first accepted `npm run data:refresh -- --accept` replaces it wholesale. Machine-written; do not hand-edit.
